sources.title: Denoising-and-4x-Super-Resolution-of-Low-Light-Images
sources.snippet: The pipeline is built around a pretrained Real-ESRGAN model (anime fine-tuned variant) for super-resolution, integrated with non-local means denoising from OpenCV to handle low-light noise artifacts before upscaling. The implementation is optimized for GPU acceleration and structured for batch inference on large image sets.

sources.title: GitHub - output9/denoising-4x-super-resolution-low-light-images
sources.snippet: A deep-learning image restoration project for recovering clean, high-resolution images from noisy low-light inputs. The final pipeline uses a compact EDSR-style ×4 super-resolution network, low-light/noise-aware augmentation, PSNR-oriented losses, EMA/SWA checkpointing, test-time augmentation, tiled inference, and checkpoint ensembling.
